hypothesis: The QF TET10 modal route can compute and report the first four modes of a one-element, one-face-fixed model; an independent dense eigensolver on the same assembled reduced K/M can check returned eigenfrequencies without validating TET10 spatial accuracy.

model.geometry: unit right tetrahedron with standard ten-node midside placement
model.element: one quadratic TET10 with the default linear-elastic stiffness and consistent mass
model.boundary_conditions: UX, UY, UZ fixed at the six TET10 nodes on the x=0 face; 12 free DOFs remain
model.initial_or_forcing_conditions: not applicable to an undamped free-vibration eigenproblem

reference.method: scipy.linalg.eigh generalized symmetric eigenproblem on the same QF-assembled Kff and Mff
reference.scope: numerical cross-check of this route on the same discrete operators
not_established: a modal transient basis for J9

observables: QF route numerical status and modal residual-validation payload
returned frequency count, payload validity, and any finite positive frequencies
relative frequency differences for returned modes in ascending order when present
dense-reference frequencies, reduced K/M, and modal vectors in the state archive

status_rules.PASS: must include exactly four finite positive frequencies and finite four-mode vectors; report comparison against dense same-operator frequencies
status_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: must remain INCONCLUSIVE; serialize any usable outputs and the exact validation reason, or serialize empty modal outputs with validity diagnostics
status_rules.FAIL: must remain FAIL if returned by QF; serialize available diagnostics without relabeling it as a numerical PASS
status_rules.thresholds: no formal frequency-accuracy threshold; this route smoke is diagnostic only

execution.budget_semantics: timeout and captured-output caps are launcher-controlled; RSS, process, temporary/archive size, and free-disk limits are sampled/soft controls, not OS quotas
execution.preflight: one exact-node pytest collect-only receipt is required before the single attempt
execution.external_solver: not used; this small route comparison uses SciPy on the same QF assembled operators
